assumptions.assumption: Option-free bullet; redemption100; zero accrued at original settlement; no business-day adjustment
assumptions.rationale: Bounded original-settlement risk illustration pending issue-specific terms
assumptions.sensitivity: Optionality or redemption changes would require a different model

assumptions.assumption: Annual15May; first payment15May2025; short coupon36/365; fractional annual discount exponent
assumptions.rationale: Coupon and maturity are sourced; first payment, fraction and calendar are assumptions
assumptions.sensitivity: Alternate first payment15May2026 with long coupon calculated separately

assumptions.assumption: Single annually compounded discount yield; rate and spread shocks add in parallel
assumptions.value: price anchor99.627; shock grid minus100 to plus150bp
assumptions.units: price per100; basis points of annual yield
assumptions.rationale: Transparent duration/convexity risk calculation; no observed spread curve available
assumptions.sensitivity: Not a key-rate, OAS, default or holding-period total-return model

assumptions.assumption: Hypothetical comparator has identical cash flows and rate exposure; greenium=conventional yield-green yield
assumptions.rationale: Isolate price mechanics without inventing market observations
assumptions.sensitivity: Real comparator coupon, maturity, liquidity and curve differences must be adjusted

assumptions.assumption: Two-year horizon;20bp incremental round-trip cost of green position versus comparator; constant duration; no roll-down
assumptions.value: 2 years;20bp cost; default maximum yield concession0bp
assumptions.units: years; basis points of market value for cost; basis points of yield for concession
assumptions.rationale: Explicit hurdle for evaluating a proposed label premium; no expected compression embedded
assumptions.sensitivity: Recalculate with executable costs, actual curves, mandate and holding period

assumptions.assumption: Additional one-off net losses of1% or3% of2024 loans at cost reduce own funds one-for-one
assumptions.units: fraction of loan book at cost
assumptions.rationale: Show static loss-absorption scale with no credit for future profits, capital calls or recoveries
assumptions.sensitivity: No risk-weighted-asset, regulatory-capital, funding, guarantee or correlation model

assumptions.assumption: Settlement 20 October 2025 and exit 20 October 2027; green annual 15 May / conventional annual 15 October; assumed Actual/Actual reference-period accrued interest; option-free redemption at 100; dates unadjusted
assumptions.rationale: Use dated cash flows and clean/dirty accounting without declaring unverified legal terms. Comparator schedule anchor dates are model anchors, not original issue dates.
assumptions.sensitivity: Actual issue terms, holidays, ex-coupon rules and payment adjustment can change settlement economics

assumptions.assumption: Illustrative ACT/365F continuously compounded zero curve; linear zero interpolation without extrapolation; conventional flat z-spread 50bp; greenium is conventional minus green z-spread
assumptions.value: Explicit zero nodes, spreads and shocks in holding-period-inputs.json
assumptions.units: decimal continuous zero rates; bp of continuous z-spread
assumptions.rationale: Adjust different coupons and maturities on a common assumed curve. No historical curve fitted and no observed greenium measured.
assumptions.sensitivity: Parallel rate, slope and common EIB spread shocks; residual key-rate differences disclosed

assumptions.assumption: Green entry/exit each 15bp of dirty value; conventional each 5bp; coupons reinvested and signed benchmark cash/funding balance earns/pays 2.5% continuous
assumptions.units: bp of dirty market value; decimal annual continuous rates
assumptions.rationale: Explicit incremental costs and dated cash balances; no observed bid/offer, financing advantage or tax benefit
assumptions.sensitivity: Substitute matched observed executable costs and actual funding/reinvestment; benchmark can include a financing requirement

assumptions.assumption: Match initial parallel curve DV01 via comparator face and disclose remaining key-rate risk; static residual-tenor curve vs initial implied-forward curve separates carry and roll-down
assumptions.value: Finite-difference DV01 and full cash-flow holding-period decomposition
assumptions.units: per 100 green face; return bp of green initial outlay
assumptions.rationale: Avoid treating equal face or similar maturity as equal rate exposure; nonparallel curve risk remains
assumptions.sensitivity: Two bonds alone cannot neutralize all key rates; rate-first spread-second decomposition is order-dependent
